title: Zettlr --data-dir + Pandoc export integration contract
purpose: Concrete interface contract and shell adapter connecting Zettlr's --data-dir profile isolation (art_01M6WJTB83S88GF5B1H8H1V5EP r1) to a Pandoc batch-export workflow. Defines the three interfaces that must hold, the failure modes when they don't, and a minimal launch-and-export shell script. Documentary; not run.
